comment: HS mismatch — company kept, codes corrected (rule 3). Declared 392690 (other plastics), 401693 (rubber gaskets/seals), 820770 (milling tools), 820780 (turning tools) do not correspond to the actual catalogue: the company sells complete metal-cutting and metal-forming machine tools (HS 8457-8462), machine-tool accessories such as rotary tables and power chucks (8465/8466), and gear measuring/roll-testing instruments (9031). Declared codes look like a plastics/rubber-seal and cutting-insert profile, i.e. a different supplier's declaration. Industry claimed as 'oil & gas and chemicals' is also misclassified: the site positions the firm in metal machining for automobile, aerospace, medical, mining, defence and power generation — no oil & gas or chemical equipment appears in the catalogue. Trader signs: the site explicitly says 'our product representation includes the best machine tools manufacturing companies from India, Japan, German and Taiwan' and lists third-party brands (UCAM, TPR Osaka, Kanzaki Kokyukoki, 3A Yantra, Sohit, Vishal, Hardik, Geeta, Matrix UK) — this is representation/distribution, not own manufacturing, despite 'Engineering the Future of Machines' marketing language. Product lines missing from the declaration: gear-cutting and gear-finishing machines, grinding machines, VMCs, lathes, drilling machines, cutting/welding machines, measuring instruments, software. All product data here is from the company's own website only — no customs line corroborates any of it, so every line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Sub-pages (/products/, /about-us/, /contact-us/) returned 404, so no further catalogue detail or HS-relevant specs are public; no PAN, GST or registration data was researched per role scope.
